scope_of_deliverables.value: Olds College of Agriculture and Technology (Olds College) is seeking a Learning Management System (LMS) Platform & Support, either by enhancing its existing Moodle LMS or implementing a new LMS system. The scope is detailed in Section D: Scope of Work and Pricing Schedule (pages 19-22), which includes functional requirements such as Development & Management of Learning Content, Assessment, Engagement & Communication, Artificial Intelligence, Support for Multiple Delivery Modalities, Academic Integrity, and technical requirements including Accessibility, Mobile Learning, Integrations, Security, Data Migration, Cloud-Based System, Data Analytics, Customer Support, and Implementation.
scope_of_deliverables.quote:
SECTION D – SCOPE OF WORK & PRICING SCHEDULE - SPECIFICATIONS
SCOPE OF WORK
Detailed LMS System Requirements
Functional Requirements - Student Experience and Quality Instruction
#1 Development & Management of Learning Content
• Contains a course organizational structure and ability to manage courses (e.g. templates)
• Ability to develop course learning materials in the system
• Ability to incorporate existing content into the system
• Ensures calendar functionality (including ease of integration with various external calendars) for individual students’ comprehensive activities and milestones
• Supports integration of external learning content (eg. digital textbooks such as Vital Source, McGraw-Hill)
• Directly supports H5P
#2 Assessment
• Ability to develop and manage gradebooks in an efficient manner
• Student access to grade information
• Access to a variety of assessment templates and tools
• Ability to develop assessment tools
• Ability for students to submit work in multiple formats via the system
• Ability for instructors to provide timely formative and summative feedback

pricing_structure.value: Pricing is evaluated as a scored criterion with a maximum of 40 points, based on the Total Cost of Proposal (see Section D - Pricing Schedule for breakdown). The pricing submission must be in Canadian dollars, fixed for the entire 5-year term, and provided in the format specified in Schedule D - Scope of Work and Pricing Schedule. The evaluation criteria table (page 15) assigns 40 points to Pricing, and section 8.4 (page 17) specifies that proponents should provide comprehensive project pricing for all goods and services as detailed in Section D. No numeric scoring formula (e.g., lowest price normalization) is provided; pricing is judged qualitatively based on the total cost submitted in the required format.

insurance_requirements.quote:
Comprehensive General Liability insurance in an amount of not less than two million dollars ($2,000,000) inclusive per occurrence against third party claims for bodily injury, personal injury, and property damage (including loss of use thereof). Such insurance shall cover all operations of the insured and include, but not being limited to: products and completed operations liability, blanket written contractual liability, owners and contractors protective liability, owners and employees as additional insured, and
Insurance on property of others on an “all risks” basis, including theft, and in an amount sufficient to cover such property in the Contractor’s care, custody and control.
Unless waived in writing by College, the Contractor shall at its own cost, obtain and maintain in full force and effect for the Term of this Agreement, general liability insurance in a form satisfactory to Olds College in the minimum amount of $5,000,000 per occurrence or such greater or lesser amount as Olds College may require or permit.
